key_insight: Block-diagonal product states have vanishing basis-dependent correlations under both Tsallis-relative-entropy and quantum-Fisher-information coherence measures.
engineering_relevance: These structural criteria may help analyze how coherence is distributed across composite quantum systems, rather than directly improve quantum hardware.
method: Compare bipartite and reduced-state coherence in fixed local orthogonal bases.
Prove vanishing correlations for block-diagonal product states using Tsallis relative entropy.
Extend the analysis to quantum Fisher information and characterize two-qubit constraints.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical proofs and special-case structural characterizations, with no experimental data or numerical benchmarks described.
watch_item: Converse characterizations depend on the coherence measure and apply only in specified special cases; basis choice also matters.
paper_title: Quantum Coherence and Basis-Dependent Correlations in Quantum Systems
